name: DeNxNver 2026
information: Welcome back for a third rendition of DeNxNver! This is a winter competition put on by Colorado Cubers. All competitors must read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcHB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--681018add857b2b9ddfd57914855080eeb87357a/Colorado%20Cubers%20Logo%20NT.png) Even though on-the-spot registration is enabled, do not count on this! If the competition fills up, we won't be able to accept on-the-spot registrations, even if competitors do not show up. If you are able, we very much appreciate you registering in advance to save us time and effort, and save you some money!
